comment: This variant's granted scope excludes offline_access, so this module (which specifically re-tests refresh behavior) has nothing to do and skips - matches the accompanying FAPIEnsureServerConfigurationDoesNotSupportRefreshToken warning in expected-warnings-baseline.json.

Deterministic, permanent skip: this test requires an RSA client key to sign an RS256 client assertion, and this AS's registered clients only ever use ES256 (see oidf-config/baseline.config.json and cmd/conformance-as's algorithm policy - no RSA support by design). The suite's own skip message confirms this does not prevent certification.
